_provenance.selection_methodology: Hand-authored must/must_not records built directly on entities and non-entities vendored_seed.json already documents, so no new judgment call about what's sensitive is made in this fixture: `must` entries reuse `persons`/`terms` entries (blindfold targets per ADR-0013); `must_not` entries reuse ADR-0013's own curation notes on what was explicitly excluded from the entity graph (org_units are structure, never blindfolded) plus a near-miss token that shares no L2 surface form with any seeded variation (token-boundary guard, not a curated exception). One record adds a real L1 PII must entry (RFC 2606 .example email, unrelated to any seeded entity so the L1 regex path -- not L2 -- is what's under test). One record's must entry is tagged layer L3 (a novel org name, deliberately not seeded anywhere) to exercise the L1/L2-only gating skip -- CI has no local adjudicator, and #260/ADR-0048 hold that even a wired one wouldn't be reproducible yet. Issue #277: a NANPA-shaped phone number without a leading '+' (`_PHONE_RE` requires one) used to be pinned here as a `must_not` -- an asserted detection gap, not a guarded false positive. The maintainer's hybrid decision (a loose phone-shaped candidate producer, adjudicated by L3) makes these `must` again, tagged layer L3 like the novel-org record above (candidate confirmation needs a wired adjudicator this CI doesn't have). Their `must_not` siblings are the false-positive surface a loose matcher creates: two dash-shaped confusables (an invoice reference, a weight range) still match the matcher and are tagged layer L3 -- only a wired adjudicator's contextual rejection actually proves those stay unblindfolded (the shape alone doesn't rule them out, by design). Two more (a dotted build/version fragment, a decimal GPS coordinate) surfaced during the issue's own blast-radius measurement against a synthetic agentic-traffic sample and drove a matcher tightening (dash-only, never dot, for the exchange-line pair) -- those are matcher-excluded outright, not L3-gated, so they carry no `layer` key. Issue #369/ADR-0055: the `must` phone values moved from `555-0142` to `555-0242` because the matcher now excludes the NANPA fictional `555-0100..0199` range outright (Blindfold's own reserved phone-surrogate namespace, re-detected as a false positive on #74 run 3) -- a fourth `must_not` entry pins `555-0142` itself, untagged like the version/coordinate entries, since the exclusion is provable in CI with no adjudicator wired.
